title: Apple seeks approval to buy chips from blacklisted Chinese company, FT reports
title_zh: 据英国《金融时报》报道，苹果寻求批准从被列入黑名单的中国公司购买芯片
summary: Apple is lobbying the Trump administration for clearance to buy memory chips from ChangXin ‌Memory Technologies, a Chinese company the Pentagon has ‌put on a blacklist, the Financial Times reported on Friday.
summary_zh: 据英国《金融时报》周五报道，苹果公司正在游说特朗普政府批准从长鑫存储科技公司购买存储芯片，五角大楼已将这家中国公司列入黑名单。

title: SpaceX rises modestly ahead of Russell rebalance, Nasdaq entry next
title_zh: SpaceX 在罗素调整之前小幅上涨，接下来将进入纳斯达克
summary: By Noel Randewich June 26 (Reuters) - Shares of SpaceX rose a marginal 0.15% on Friday ahead of its inclusion in Russell indexes, with passively managed funds tracking those benchmarks required to add
summary_zh: 作者：诺埃尔·兰德维奇 (Noel Randewich) 6 月 26 日（路透社）——周五，SpaceX 的股价在被纳入罗素指数之前小幅上涨 0.15%，被动管理基金跟踪了纳入罗素指数所需的基准。

title: SpaceX set to join Nasdaq 100, paving way for wave of passive buying
title_zh: SpaceX将加入纳斯达克100指数，为被动购买浪潮铺平道路
summary: SpaceX will be added to the tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 index on July 7, exchange operator Nasdaq confirmed on Friday, ‌paving the way for a surge in passive investments in Elon ‌Musk's rocket and AI giant. To make it more attractive for companies seeking U.S.
summary_zh: 交易所运营商纳斯达克周五证实，SpaceX 将于 7 月 7 日被纳入以科技股为主的纳斯达克 100 指数，这为埃隆·马斯克的火箭和人工智能巨头被动投资激增铺平了道路。使其对寻求美国的公司更具吸引力

title: GameStop pledges to pursue its takeover offer for eBay despite rejection
title_zh: 尽管遭到拒绝，GameStop 仍承诺继续对 eBay 提出收购要约
summary: GameStop pledged on Friday to pursue its proposed takeover ‌of eBay, even after the e-commerce firm rejected ‌an unsolicited cash-and-stock offer of about $56 billion from the videogame retailer.
summary_zh: GameStop 周五承诺继续收购 eBay，尽管这家电子商务公司拒绝了这家视频游戏零售商主动提出的约 560 亿美元的现金加股票要约。

title: Zuckerberg asks Meta to explore working with Polymarket and Kalshi, NYT reports
title_zh: 据《纽约时报》报道，扎克伯格要求 Meta 探索与 Polymarket 和 Kalshi 合作
summary: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg has urged his lieutenants to explore partnerships with the popular prediction markets ‌Polymarket and Kalshi as his company builds a similar ‌app, the New York Times said on Friday, citing three employees with knowledge ​of the matter.
summary_zh: 《纽约时报》周五援引三名知情员工的话说，Meta 首席执行官马克·扎克伯格 (Mark Zuckerberg) 敦促其副手探索与热门预测市场 Polymarket 和 Kalshi 的合作，因为他的公司正在开发一款类似的应用程序。

title: Apple’s Vision Pro and Smart Glasses Chief to Join OpenAI
title_zh: 苹果 Vision Pro 和智能眼镜主管将加入 OpenAI
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Apple Inc.’s top executive in charge of the Vision Pro headset and the company’s smart glasses efforts is leaving for OpenAI, continuing a streak of high-profile defections to rivals in the artificial intelligence and hardware sectors.Most Read from BloombergLut...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——苹果公司负责 Vision Pro 耳机和公司智能眼镜业务的高管即将离职前往 OpenAI，继续高调倒戈人工智能和硬件领域的竞争对手。 大多数内容来自 BloombergLut...

title: What turning AI compute into a financial asset would look like
title_zh: 将人工智能计算转变为金融资产会是什么样子
summary: What exactly does it mean when investors want to "financialize" AI computing, a.k.a, turning it into a liquid financial asset or market?
summary_zh: 当投资者想要将人工智能计算“金融化”，也就是将其转变为流动性金融资产或市场时，这到底意味着什么？

title: Semiconductor stocks retreat over worries about memory costs
title_zh: 半导体股因内存成本担忧而下跌
summary: The semiconductor sector declined on Friday as high memory and storage costs weighed on stocks.
summary_zh: 由于高内存和存储成本打压股市，半导体板块周五下跌。

title: The AI boom now has a price tag — and Micron just sent the bill: Chart of the Day
title_zh: 人工智能的繁荣现在已经有了价格标签——美光刚刚送出了账单：每日图表
summary: Micron's blowout earnings did not just revive the AI trade — they showed how expensive it is becoming.
summary_zh: 美光科技的井喷式盈利不仅重振了人工智能行业，还表明人工智能行业正变得多么昂贵。
